dct_title_s: Northern Afghanistan Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Nov 2025
dct_description_sm: # Northern Afghanistan Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Nov 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Northern Afghanistan Earthquakes (Nov 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Samangan Province, Afghanistan, Earthquakes, 05 Nov 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Northern Afghanistan, Earthquakes, 04 Nov 2025, v0.9 ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** leaflet/EOS-RS_202511_Northern_Afghanistan_Earthquakes **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
